# clickhouse_clickstack_source_links (Resource)

Manages the correlated-source links of a ClickStack source (`log_source_id`, `trace_source_id`, `metric_source_id`, `session_source_id`), separately from `clickhouse_clickstack_source`. Use it when two sources link to each other, which a `clickhouse_clickstack_source` cannot express because each needs the other's ID: create both sources without the reverse link and set it here.

Only the links set in config are managed; other links on the source are left alone. Destroying the resource clears the links it manages. Use at most one of these resources per source, and do not also set the same link on the `clickhouse_clickstack_source` itself, or the two will overwrite each other.

Which links a source accepts depends on its kind: `log` takes `metric_source_id` and `trace_source_id`; `trace` takes `log_source_id`, `metric_source_id` and `session_source_id`; `session` takes `trace_source_id`; `metric` takes `log_source_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Logs and traces that link to each other. Each link needs the other source's
# ID, so one direction is set on the source itself and the other here, after
# both sources exist.
resource "clickhouse_clickstack_source" "logs" {
  name          = "Logs"
  kind          = "log"
  connection_id = clickhouse_clickstack_connection.main.id

  from = {
    database_name = "otel"
    table_name    = "otel_logs"
  }

  timestamp_value_expression      = "Timestamp"
  default_table_select_expression = "Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body"

  trace_source_id = clickhouse_clickstack_source.traces.id
}

resource "clickhouse_clickstack_source" "traces" {
  name          = "Traces"
  kind          = "trace"
  connection_id = clickhouse_clickstack_connection.main.id

  from = {
    database_name = "otel"
    table_name    = "otel_traces"
  }

  timestamp_value_expression      = "Timestamp"
  default_table_select_expression = "Timestamp, SpanName, ServiceName, Duration"

  duration_expression       = "Duration"
  duration_precision        = 9
  trace_id_expression       = "TraceId"
  span_id_expression        = "SpanId"
  parent_span_id_expression = "ParentSpanId"
  span_name_expression      = "SpanName"
  span_kind_expression      = "SpanKind"

  # log_source_id is left unset: clickhouse_clickstack_source_links.traces owns it.
}

resource "clickhouse_clickstack_source_links" "traces" {
  source_id     = clickhouse_clickstack_source.traces.id
  log_source_id = clickhouse_clickstack_source.logs.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_id` (String) ID of the source whose links are managed. Changing this forces the resource to be replaced.

### Optional

- `log_source_id` (String) Correlated log source ID (trace, metric). When unset, this resource leaves the link as the server holds it. Removing it from config clears it.
- `metric_source_id` (String) Correlated metric source ID (log, trace). When unset, this resource leaves the link as the server holds it. Removing it from config clears it.
- `session_source_id` (String) Correlated session source ID (trace). When unset, this resource leaves the link as the server holds it. Removing it from config clears it.
- `team` (String) Team ID the source belongs to, sent as the `x-hdx-team` header. Defaults to the API key's team. Only honored by multi-team (EE) deployments. Changing this forces the resource to be replaced.
- `trace_source_id` (String) Correlated trace source ID (log, session). When unset, this resource leaves the link as the server holds it. Removing it from config clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource; the same as `source_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Source links are imported by the ID of the source they belong to. Every link
# the source holds is imported; remove any you do not want managed from config
# afterwards, or the next apply clears it.
terraform import clickhouse_clickstack_source_links.traces 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011

# For a source in a non-default team (multi-team / EE deployments), prefix the
# ID with the team ID:
terraform import clickhouse_clickstack_source_links.traces 65f0c0ffeecafef00dba5e01/507f1f77bcf86cd799439011
```
